notes.title: Update the game's cover art
notes.content:
Dear friends, thank you for your anticipation and support! I apologize that the game is still not released - I keep working on it to make it as good as possible.

Today I want to share with you the new cover of the game. Before the release I decided to update it to more accurately convey the atmosphere and concept of the project. I hope you will like it!

I'll try to prepare another post with new information in the nearest future, as well as possibly announce the release date. Thank you for your patience and interest in the game!

Regards,
David Pankov

notes.title: PUBLIC DEMO VERSION
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are glad that we can share with you part of the game, Nightmare Within is an atmospheric horror game created in Unreal Engine 5 by a sole developer. Explore the dark corners of the house with a flashlight and solve puzzles while trying not to yell. We will be waiting for your feedback and suggestions, be sure to add the game to your wish list, it will be available soon

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061950/Nightmare_Within/

notes.title: Official trailer
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today the official trailer for Nightmare Within was released. This means that there will be a demo version very soon, I will be glad if you add the game to your wish list

notes.title: Demo version coming soon!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, dear players![/b]

We are thrilled to announce that very soon you will be able to personally experience the demo version of our anticipated game "Nightmare Within." We are confident it will make you hold your breath and feel the true horror awakening deep inside.

As we approach the release, we would like to share with you an exclusive video featuring gameplay snippets from the demo version. Expect unpredictable plot twists and challenging puzzles that we have prepared for you.

This video is just a small part of what awaits you in the full version of the game. We are working tirelessly to ensure that every element of the game is unmatched, and every level keeps you wanting to play again and again.

[previewyoutube=VkwsEiJJ-Jk;full][/previewyoutube]

Subscribe to our updates, add the game to your wishlist, and don't forget to share your thoughts on the demo version! We value each and every one of you and your support, as it inspires us to create something truly unique and memorable.

We look forward to meeting you in "Nightmare Within"!

Sincerely,
Angellios Arcade
